items.title: Emile Christian and Anthony Sbarbaro Interview, 1959-02-11
items.q: They told me it was Girard's funeral and I stood by, yeah.

ctx.x: Yeah, I was at his funeral. Oh, did I happen to be passing then? They told me it was Girard's funeral and I stood by, yeah. Well, it was about two years ago.
I was working with him then.
